text: Latent reprojection: hidden channels are learned per-point descriptors that travel with depth
description: Reproject latent features together with RGB-D, since every latent sits on a 3D point. Prior art: Neural Point-Based Graphics (Aliev 2020), ADOP. VAE latents (as in GameNGen/Stable Diffusion) warp badly, because 8×8 patches aren't shift-equivariant; EQ-VAE-style work tries to fix that. Prefer per-pixel latents at low resolution over patch latents.
